drhp.business: Meghna Infracon Infrastructure creates value through residential development and redevelopment opportunities in established urban locations in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. Its redevelopment-led approach is intended to give access to attractive locations while potentially reducing the capital intensity of outright land acquisition. Projects are sourced through redevelopment, partnerships and other development structures, and development is carried out partly through partnership/LLP subsidiaries.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Delays in land, construction, environmental and other statutory approvals may affect project timelines, increase carrying costs and impact project feasibility.
- Redevelopment involves extended negotiations with society members, approvals, rehabilitation obligations and execution complexity, which could hit timelines and costs of the core redevelopment-led model.
- Performance depends on sales and rental realisations of its projects, driven by market conditions, project nature and location, brand, reputation and design.
- Volatility in cement, steel and other material prices, together with labour costs, may raise project costs and pressure margins.
- Changes in interest rates and availability/cost of capital affect both homebuyer affordability and the Company's financing costs in a capital-intensive industry.
- Competition from well-capitalised organised developers may pressure pricing, customer acquisition and market share; continued price increases could constrain affordability.
- Shortages of skilled manpower can affect construction schedules and increase execution costs.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Residential development and redevelopment in established urban locations of Mumbai/MMR; redevelopment-led approach used to access attractive locations while potentially reducing the capital intensity of outright land acquisition.
- Balanced project sourcing across redevelopment opportunities, partnerships and other development structures where the underlying economics and execution profile are attractive.
